verdict.rationale: Keycloak's docs explicitly state social login is added via admin console configuration with 'No code or changes to your application required,' and identity brokering extends this to any OIDC/SAML IdP, plus account linking across providers. Community evidence corroborates successful integration of many external IdPs for SSO in production (keycloak-comm-5, keycloak-comm-14), supporting the configuration-only claim in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the social-login admin UI flow (vs. general SSO praise), and no enumerated list of supported social providers in the evidence.
